title: cad-drawings edit plan
description: Input of `cad.py edit --spec edits.json`. Every edit targets one entity by handle and carries the state the agent expects to find. The executor checks `expect` before touching anything; a mismatch aborts that edit (exit 6) and nothing is written in --dry-run. Handles are valid only for the exact file version named in `base`.

path.description: Drawing the handles were read from.

sha1.description: Hash of that file; the executor refuses a plan whose base changed.

path.description: Edited copy to write. Default: a new file in the run directory. The original is never modified.

note.description: Free text kept in the change log (why the change is made).

expect.description: Preconditions on the target as currently found. Give at least `type`.

type.description: DXF entity type, e.g. TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT, LINE, VIEWPORT.

text.description: Current text. For MTEXT compared against the raw string unless `text_is_plain` is true.

attrib.description: Tag -> current value for INSERT attributes.

id.description: Unique within the plan; appears in changes.jsonl.

old.description: replace-text: substring or exact raw text to replace. Must occur exactly once unless `count` is given.

new.description: replace-text: replacement. MTEXT formatting codes outside the match are preserved.

props.description: set-props: DXF property -> value (layer, color, height, rotation, ...).

vector.description: move: displacement; clone: offset of the copy from the source.

target_layer.description: clone: layer of the copy (default: source layer).

target_space.description: clone: layout or model space that receives the copy (default: source space).

view_center.description: pan-viewport: new model-space view center. Scale and size stay unchanged.
